name: M42
note: A thread, not a product: Praktica, Pentax, Zenit, Chinon and others all used it, and no one of them owns it. That is why a mount has no brand segment in its URL. The bare spelling `Screw` is ruled here rather than under `leica-m39`: it comes from the Edixa Reflex, a West German SLR built by Wirgin on the M42 thread.
